usage: arb-engine games [-h] [--date DATE] [--live-only] [--enrich] [--sport {nfl,ncaaf,nba,nhl}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --date DATE           YYYY-MM-DD (default: current week)
  --live-only
  --enrich              also pull each game's summary (ESPN win probability)
  --sport {nfl,ncaaf,nba,nhl}
